title: Membership of Encoded Inputs in EXPCOM
statement: For Boolean words $\alpha$ and $x$ and a natural number $n$, the word $\langle\alpha,\langle x,1^n\rangle\rangle$ belongs to $\mathrm{EXPCOM}$ if and only if the machine decoded from $\alpha$ computes the output word $[1]$ on input $x$ in exactly $2^n$ steps.
replaced:
For all Boolean words $\alpha,x$ and all $n\in\mathbb{N}$, the encoding
$\langle\alpha,\langle x,1^n\rangle\rangle$ belongs to $\mathrm{EXPCOM}$ if and only if
the machine decoded from $\alpha$ halts on input $x$, outputs the one-bit word $[1]$,
and uses exactly $2^n$ steps.
